title: Approximate tangent plane of the chart image of a small ball at its centre (parent steps 2 and 4–9)
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, let V ⊆ ℝ^m be open, let ψ : ℝ^m → ℝ^P be of class C¹ on V (ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V), and let v₀ ∈ V be a point at which Dψ(v₀) = fderiv ℝ ψ v₀ is injective. Then there is ρ > 0 such that the open ball B_ρ(v₀) is contained in V and the linear subspace T := range Dψ(v₀) of ℝ^P is the approximate tangent space of the set ψ(B_ρ(v₀)) at the point ψ(v₀) in the sense of Simon Ch. 3, Definition 1.4 (HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m (ψ(B_ρ(v₀))) (ψ(v₀)) T): dim T = m, and ∫_{η_{ψ(v₀),r}(ψ(B_ρ(v₀)))} f dH^m → ∫_T f dH^m as r ↓ 0 for every continuous compactly supported f : ℝ^P → ℝ, where η_{x,r}(y) = r^{-1}(y − x) and H^m = μHE[m].
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (V : Set (Euclid m)) (ψ : Euclid m → Euclid P) (v₀ : Euclid m), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 ψ V → v₀ ∈ V → Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ v₀) → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ball v₀ ρ ⊆ V ∧ HasApproximateTangentSpaceAt m (ψ '' ball v₀ ρ) (ψ v₀) (LinearMap.range (fderiv ℝ ψ v₀ : Euclid m →ₗ[ℝ] Euclid P))
